//: Used in: components/billing/LockedBudgetSheet (lockedBudgetSheet namespace). Explains locked credits via a share-lifecycle timeline.
title: Locked credits
intro: Locked credits belong to shares that haven't been paid out yet. We set them aside so there's always enough to pay the customer.

shared.title: A customer shares your business
shared.body: We estimate what they could earn for the post and lock that amount from your credits.

price.title: We calculate the final price
price.body: After 24 hours we measure how many people actually saw the post and what it was really worth to your business.

paid.title: The customer gets paid
paid.body: The reward comes out of the locked amount. Anything left over returns straight to your available credits.
